name: announcer
description: A game announcer's call when Claude finishes a task, and a sound for what it does on the way (asks, commits, pushes, fails a test).

sound.title: Win call: sound
sound.description: Off: the call is text only, and the action pack's task-done sound marks the win instead.

detect.title: Win call: how a win is detected
detect.description: marker: Claude's own spaced-caps call in its answer. tools: the turn edited files and its last test/build/lint passed. both: either. off: no win calls at all, action sounds only (drop the CLAUDE.md line too). 'Action sounds' off is the other way round.

volume.title: Volume
volume.description: How loud the win call and the action sounds play, of each clip's full level.

calls.title: Quiet on calls
calls.description: No sound while any app is using the microphone (a call, dictation); cues still show. Windows only.

actions.title: Action sounds
actions.description: A sound for what Claude does: asks you, commits, pushes, fails a test, gets compacted. free: the shipped pack. personal: your own clips (scripts/packs.py), the free one where you have none. 'Action sounds: one row each' lets each action override it. /announcer list shows them.

spacing.title: Action sounds: same one again after
spacing.description: An action that sounded this recently stays silent (its cue still shows): fewer edit, test and error sounds on a busy run. Questions, permission dialogs, force and destructive commands always sound.

cues.title: Action sounds: cues
cues.description: A one-line animation just above the prompt, naming the action and what triggered it, while its sound plays. An action set off gets neither.

cue_duration.title: Action sounds: cue duration
cue_duration.description: How long a cue stays above the prompt. Longer gives you time to find which of several terminals just sounded.

subagents.title: Action sounds: subagents
subagents.description: Off: spawning a subagent and its end notification make no sound and no cue. A subagent's permission dialog always sounds.

each_action.title: Action sounds: one row each
each_action.description: Show a row per action below, to set one off or to another pack. Off hides the rows; what they are set to still applies (/announcer list shows it).

question.title: Action: question
question.description: Claude asks you (AskUserQuestion, a plan to approve). default: as 'Action sounds' says.

permission.title: Action: permission
permission.description: A permission dialog opens. default: as 'Action sounds' says.

subagent.title: Action: subagent
subagent.description: Claude spawns a subagent (only with 'Sounds for subagents' on). default: as 'Action sounds' says.

edit.title: Action: edit
edit.description: The turn's first file edit. default: as 'Action sounds' says.

big_refactor.title: Action: big-refactor
big_refactor.description: The tenth file edited in one turn. default: as 'Action sounds' says.

tests_fail.title: Action: tests-fail
tests_fail.description: A test/build/lint run fails (once a turn). default: as 'Action sounds' says.

green_after_red.title: Action: green-after-red
green_after_red.description: A test/build/lint run passes after one failed. default: as 'Action sounds' says.

tool_error.title: Action: tool-error
tool_error.description: An edit or an MCP call errors (once a turn). default: as 'Action sounds' says.

commit.title: Action: commit
commit.description: Git commit succeeds. default: as 'Action sounds' says.

push.title: Action: push
push.description: Git push starts. default: as 'Action sounds' says.

force.title: Action: force
force.description: A command with --force or --no-verify starts. default: as 'Action sounds' says.

destructive.title: Action: destructive
destructive.description: Rm -rf, git reset --hard, git clean -f, a force push or DROP TABLE starts. default: as 'Action sounds' says.

install.title: Action: install
install.description: A package install starts (npm, pip, uv, cargo, winget …). default: as 'Action sounds' says.

compacted.title: Action: compacted
compacted.description: The conversation is compacted. default: as 'Action sounds' says.

background_done.title: Action: background-done
background_done.description: A background task's notification arrives (a subagent's only with 'Sounds for subagents' on). default: as 'Action sounds' says.

task_done.title: Action: task-done
task_done.description: A win, when the win call's own sound is off. default: as 'Action sounds' says.

interrupted.title: Action: interrupted
interrupted.description: You interrupt a turn. default: as 'Action sounds' says.
